title: Ambassadors, Content, and the Vibe Lineup
lessons: The player sees a CELSIUS ambassador post and learns ambassadors are expected to create recurring social content for product rewards.
The player already knows CELSIUS and now recognizes new Vibe cans as flavor-led reasons to keep browsing the lineup.

text: The player sees a CELSIUS ambassador post and learns ambassadors are expected to create recurring social content for product rewards.

entry-first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: One feed post, two stories, tags, submission.

entry-first-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: You just assigned homework.

entry-first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: That is the ambassador challenge. Complete the content requirements and product can follow next month.

entry-first-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: So enthusiasm comes with deliverables.

entry-first-5.speaker: CELSIUS
text: In this program? Very much.

choice-first.speaker: CELSIUS
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: At least the relationship is pretty explicit.
A free case can still shape what someone says.
I do not want my feed full of contracted enthusiasm.

first-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Transparency helps. You can enjoy the post without pretending the incentive is invisible.

first-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Correct. Product compensation is still compensation.

first-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then scroll. I am loud enough without forcing a follow.
The player already knows CELSIUS and now recognizes new Vibe cans as flavor-led reasons to keep browsing the lineup.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Galaxy. Arctic. Tropical. Retro. Are these flavors or moods?

entry-return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Yes.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: That was not one of the options.

entry-return-4.speaker: CELSIUS
text: The energy function stays familiar. The Vibe names keep the cooler from feeling finished.

choice-return.speaker: CELSIUS
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like picking a flavor that fits the mood.
The names are doing more work than the product difference.
I do not need twenty-nine ways to buy the same energy habit.

return-1.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Pick one. Commit to the bit.

return-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Arctic.

return-1-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Correct answer emotionally. Not nutritionally.

return-2.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Often, yes. Flavor and packaging are carrying the novelty.

return-3.speaker: CELSIUS
text: Then pick one, or stop browsing. Variety is only useful if you want it.
